guardrails.name: No Secrets in Code
guardrails.rule: Code must not contain hard-coded secrets, API keys, or credentials.
guardrails.reason: Prevents credential leakage into the repository.

guardrails.name: No Client Database Access
guardrails.rule: Client and UI code must never reach the database directly.
guardrails.reason: Enforces the entry → service → repository → database boundary.

guardrails.name: Authorization Before Access
guardrails.rule: Private resource access must be preceded by authorization.
guardrails.reason: Prevents unauthorized access to data.

guardrails.name: No Unsafe Dynamic Code Execution
guardrails.rule: Never eval or construct functions from untrusted input.
guardrails.reason: Dynamic execution of untrusted input enables RCE.

guardrails.name: Parameterized Queries Only
guardrails.rule: SQL must never be assembled by string concatenation or interpolation.
guardrails.reason: Prevents SQL injection.

guardrails.name: No Empty Catch Blocks
guardrails.rule: Every catch must log, wrap, or rethrow with context.
guardrails.reason: Swallowed errors make failures undiagnosable.

guardrails.name: No TODO/FIXME Left in Committed Code
guardrails.rule: Committed code must not contain TODO, FIXME, or HACK markers.
guardrails.reason: Unresolved markers indicate unfinished or fragile work.

guardrails.name: No Console Debug Logging in Production Paths
guardrails.rule: Production code must log through the observability module, not the console.
guardrails.reason: Console logging bypasses structured, correlation-carrying logging.

guardrails.name: No Explicit `any` in TypeScript
guardrails.rule: Module boundaries must be fully typed.
guardrails.reason: `any` defeats the type system and hides defects.

guardrails.name: Tests Required for New Logic
guardrails.rule: Scoped source files must have an adjacent test file.
guardrails.reason: New logic without tests cannot be verified.

guardrails.name: No Business Logic in Entry/Controller Layer
guardrails.rule: Controllers must not import repository, persistence, or domain-model internals.
guardrails.reason: Keeps business logic out of the HTTP layer and honors the dependency rule.

guardrails.name: No Direct Filesystem Access from API Layer
guardrails.rule: The API/entry layer must not touch the filesystem directly.
guardrails.reason: Filesystem concerns belong in dedicated infrastructure adapters.

guardrails.name: No Hardcoded URLs or Connection Strings
guardrails.rule: Environment-specific endpoints and connection strings must not be literals in code.
guardrails.reason: Environment-specific values belong in validated configuration.

guardrails.name: Domain Layer Has No Framework Dependencies
guardrails.rule: Domain modules must not import HTTP or framework modules.
guardrails.reason: Keeps business rules framework-agnostic and testable.

guardrails.name: Performance: External call timeout required
guardrails.rule: All external HTTP calls, database queries, and message queue operations must have explicit timeouts.
enforcement: AST scan: external call functions must include a timeout option
guardrails.reason: Without timeouts, a single slow external service can block all threads and crash the application.
verification: Verify all fetch, axios, and HTTP calls include a timeout parameter

guardrails.name: Security: CORS policy enforcement
guardrails.rule: CORS must be configured with an explicit allowlist of origins. Wildcard (*) origin is forbidden in production.
enforcement: Config scan: CORS configuration must not use wildcard origin
guardrails.reason: Wildcard CORS allows any website to make authenticated requests to the API, enabling CSRF and data theft.
verification: Verify CORS config uses an explicit origin allowlist and not *

guardrails.name: Security: File upload size limit
guardrails.rule: File upload endpoints must enforce a maximum file size (≤ 10MB by default) and validate file type against an allowlist.
enforcement: Pattern scan: file upload middleware must configure limits.fileSize and limits.allowedMimeTypes
guardrails.reason: Unlimited file uploads enable denial of service through disk exhaustion and potential malware upload.
verification: Verify upload middleware enforces size limits and validates file types against an allowlist

guardrails.name: Security: Input validation at boundary
guardrails.rule: All external inputs (request body, query params, path params, headers) must be validated using a schema validator (Zod, Joi, class-validator) before processing.
enforcement: Pattern scan: controller/route handlers must apply validation middleware or schema checks
guardrails.reason: Unvalidated input is the root cause of injection attacks, type confusion, and unexpected behavior.
verification: Verify each endpoint has a validation schema applied to its input parameters

guardrails.name: Security: Rate limiting configuration
guardrails.rule: All public API endpoints must have rate limiting applied.
enforcement: Architecture review: global rate limiter middleware or per-route rate limits must be configured
guardrails.reason: Without rate limiting, APIs are vulnerable to brute-force attacks, denial of service, and resource exhaustion.
verification: Verify rate limiting middleware is applied globally or per-route

guardrails.name: Security: XSS prevention (output encoding)
guardrails.rule: All user-provided data rendered in HTML must be escaped. Use template engines with auto-escaping or explicit encoding functions.
enforcement: Static scan: detect dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML assignment, and document.write usage
guardrails.reason: Unescaped user data in HTML enables cross-site scripting attacks that steal credentials and session tokens.
verification: Verify no user input is injected into DOM without encoding

guardrails.name: Performance: Connection pool configuration
guardrails.rule: Database connection pools must have min and max limits configured.
enforcement: Config scan: database configuration must specify pool size limits
guardrails.reason: Unbounded connection pools exhaust database connections under load and cause connection refused errors.
verification: Verify database config includes connection pool min and max settings

guardrails.name: Performance: Missing index warning
guardrails.rule: Fields used in WHERE clauses, JOIN conditions, or ORDER BY must be indexed.
enforcement: Schema review: fields referenced in queries must appear in database indexes
guardrails.reason: Missing indexes cause full table scans that degrade performance linearly with data growth.
verification: Cross-reference query WHERE/JOIN fields against schema index definitions

guardrails.name: Performance: N+1 query detection
guardrails.rule: Database queries must not be executed inside loops. Use batch queries, joins, or eager loading.
enforcement: AST scan: detect database query calls inside for/while/forEach/map loops
guardrails.reason: N+1 queries cause exponential performance degradation as data volume grows.
verification: Identify query calls inside loop bodies and verify they are replaced with batch operations

guardrails.name: Performance: Response size limits
guardrails.rule: API responses returning lists must implement pagination. Unbounded result sets are forbidden.
enforcement: Pattern scan: GET endpoints returning arrays must accept pagination parameters
guardrails.reason: Unbounded responses consume excessive memory and network bandwidth, and degrade client performance.
verification: Verify list-returning endpoints support limit/offset or cursor-based pagination

guardrails.name: Performance: Unbounded query warning
guardrails.rule: Database queries without LIMIT, pagination, or date range filters must be flagged for review.
enforcement: AST scan: findMany/findAll calls without take/limit/skip parameters
guardrails.reason: Queries without bounds return unbounded result sets that grow over time and cause memory exhaustion.
verification: Verify all data-fetching queries include limit, pagination, or date-range filters

guardrails.name: Security: Content Security Policy
guardrails.rule: HTML responses must include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag that disallows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.
enforcement: Header scan: CSP header must not include unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval directives
guardrails.reason: Unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval in CSP defeat XSS protections and allow script injection.
verification: Verify CSP header is set and does not contain unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval

guardrails.name: Performance: Batch database operations
guardrails.rule: Bulk inserts and updates must use batch operations (createMany, upsertMany) instead of individual inserts in loops.
enforcement: AST scan: detect individual insert/update calls inside loops
guardrails.reason: Individual inserts in loops execute N separate SQL statements instead of a single batched statement.
verification: Verify bulk data operations use createMany or equivalent batch APIs
